If you’re looking for a non-surgical way to smooth out fine lines and wrinkles, especially those stubborn frown lines between your brows- Dysport is a name you’ll want to know. At Boston Medical Aesthetics, we love Dysport for its fast-acting, natural-looking results, making it a favorite among our patients who want a refreshed, youthful appearance without downtime. What Is Dysport? Dysport injections (abobotulinumtoxinA) are a type of botulinum toxin that temporarily reduces muscle activity. By targeting specific facial muscles, it helps soften dynamic wrinkles caused by repeated facial expressions like frowning, squinting, or raising your brows. A Brief History Dysport has been used medically in Europe since the early 1990s and was officially approved for cosmetic use in the U.S. by the FDA in 2009. It was originally patented by the French pharmaceutical company Ipsen and is now co-distributed for cosmetic use by Galderma, the makers of Restylane dermal fillers and other trusted aesthetic products. Where Is It Made? Dysport is manufactured in Europe, specifically France and the United Kingdom—under rigorous safety and quality standards. It’s been used in more than 70 countries worldwide and has a long-standing reputation for both cosmetic and therapeutic uses. Why People Love Dysport Dysport benefits appeal to both patients and providers for several reasons: Fast results: Many people see visible improvement much faster than other toxins. Natural-looking smoothing: Dysport spreads slightly differently than other injectable toxins, which can be beneficial for treating larger areas like the forehead and glabella (frown lines). This can result in a softer, more natural appearance. Lasting power: Results typically last around 3–4 months, depending on the individual and treatment area. Great for first-timers: Many patients find Dysport to feel lighter and more subtle than other neuromodulators, making it an excellent choice for those new to injectables. Is Dysport Right for You? If you’re looking to smooth out moderate to severe frown lines or want a more refreshed, youthful appearance without looking “frozen,” Dysport may be a great option. At Boston Medical Aesthetics, our expert injectors personalize every treatment to ensure you get results that enhance your natural beauty and maintain your unique expression with custom Dysport dosing . Ready to Learn More or Schedule a Consultation? Contact us today! We’d be happy to walk you through your options and help you decide if Dysport is the right fit for your aesthetic goals.
